title: Introduction to Retrieval-Augmented Generation
content: Retrieval-Augmented Generation, also known as RAG, combines document retrieval with language model generation. The application retrieves relevant information from a knowledge source and passes it to a language model to generate a context-grounded answer.

title: Azure AI Search
content: Azure AI Search is a managed search service that can index documents and retrieve relevant information. It supports full-text search, vector search, and hybrid search. A RAG application can use search results as context for a language model.

title: Agentic RAG
content: Agentic RAG adds an agent orchestration layer to retrieval-augmented generation. The agent can decide when to retrieve information, use tools, evaluate intermediate results, and formulate a final answer.
